label: Hypnos system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Hypnos locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Hypnos branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual HyoA genes, HyoA proteins, the DefenseFinder Hypnos__HyoA HMM profile, source-database rows naming one Hypnos locus, unresolved Hypnos triggers or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
